Eruption-age likelihoods from single-zircon U-Pb dates (for astroMCBchron)

Source: R/upb_grain_loglik.R
upb_grain_loglik.Rd

upb_grain_loglik() turns single-zircon dates of one or more ash beds into one eruption-age log-likelihood function per bed, for the date_loglik argument of astroMCBchron. Instead of a weighted mean, every grain is modelled as a draw from a mixture of

  • a crystallisation interval: the grain crystallised uniformly between the eruption age te and te + D (antecrystic growth before eruption), with the duration D marginalised over a uniform prior between 0 and D_max;

  • inherited or recycled grains (probability p_inherit): uniform over W_inherit before the eruption;

  • grains with residual Pb loss (probability p_pbloss): uniform over W_pbloss after the eruption,

each convolved with the analytical uncertainty of the grain. The likelihood of te is computed on a grid, so no grain has to be rejected beforehand. With D_max = 0 and no mixture components the result is the likelihood of a weighted mean; with a large D_max the eruption age approaches the youngest concordant grains (as in the Bayesian eruption-age estimator of Keller et al., 2018). Which regime applies depends on the ratio of the crystallisation interval to the analytical uncertainty of the grains, which is why the choice is left to the data rather than fixed beforehand.

The functions return a log-likelihood (not a posterior): no prior is placed on te, so the stratigraphic order and the astrochronology in astroMCBchron act as the prior. astroMCBchron normalises each function numerically and combines it with its outlier mixture.

Usage

upb_grain_loglik(
  grains,
  D_max = 0.6,
  p_inherit = 0.1,
  p_pbloss = 0.05,
  W_inherit = 20,
  W_pbloss = 3,
  step = 0.002,
  nD = 61
)

Arguments

grains

Single-grain dates (data frame) with the columns id (name of the bed, character or factor), age (single-grain date, numeric, in Ma or any other age unit used consistently with D_max, W_inherit, W_pbloss and step) and either sd (analytical 1 sigma uncertainty) or sd2 (analytical 2 sigma uncertainty, halved). Rows with missing ages or uncertainties are skipped. Required, no default.

D_max

Maximum duration of the crystallisation interval before the eruption (numeric, >= 0, in age units); the duration D is marginalised over a uniform prior between 0 and D_max. 0 gives the likelihood of a weighted mean, large values move the eruption age towards the youngest grains. Default=0.6 (Ma).

p_inherit

Probability that a grain is inherited or recycled (numeric, >= 0; p_inherit + p_pbloss must be < 1); such grains are modelled as uniform over W_inherit older than the eruption. Default=0.1.

p_pbloss

Probability that a grain suffered residual Pb loss (numeric, >= 0); such grains are modelled as uniform over W_pbloss younger than the eruption. Default=0.05.

W_inherit

Width of the inherited-grain component, i.e. how much older than the eruption inherited grains can be (numeric, > 0, in age units). Default=20 (Ma).

W_pbloss

Width of the Pb-loss component, i.e. how much younger than the eruption grains with Pb loss can appear (numeric, > 0, in age units). Default=3 (Ma).

step

Grid step of the eruption age on which the likelihood is computed (numeric, > 0, in age units); smaller steps are more precise and slower. Default=0.002 (2 kyr for ages in Ma).

nD

Number of grid values of the crystallisation duration D between 0 and D_max used for the marginalisation (integer, >= 1). Default=61.

Value

A list with loglik (named list of functions, one per bed, of the eruption age in age units) and summary (data.frame per bed: number of grains, maximum- likelihood eruption age, mean and 2 sd of the normalised likelihood, youngest grain and weighted mean with MSWD for comparison).

References

Keller, C.B., Schoene, B., Samperton, K.M., 2018. A stochastic sampling approach to zircon eruption age interpretation. Geochemical Perspectives Letters 8, 31-35.

Examples

set.seed(2)
g <- data.frame(id = rep(c("ashA", "ashB"), each = 8),
                age = c(430 + runif(8, 0, 0.1) + rnorm(8, 0, 0.04),
                        431 + runif(8, 0, 0.1) + rnorm(8, 0, 0.04)),
                sd = 0.04)
g$age[3] <- 433.2                                     # one inherited grain
gl <- upb_grain_loglik(g)
gl$summary
#>     id n    te_ml  te_mean    te_2sd youngest youngest_2sd   wm_all wm_all_2sd
#> 1 ashA 8 430.0012 429.9858 0.1104326 430.0072         0.08 430.4641 0.02828427
#> 2 ashB 8 431.0032 430.9885 0.1037042 430.9652         0.08 431.0666 0.02828427
#>     mswd_all
#> 1 765.789909
#> 2   2.186294
